note: Fictional front-desk calls for Riverbend Physical Therapy. A = staff (front desk), C = caller. Labels: pass | fail | na.

calls.title: Clean new-patient booking
lines: Thank you for calling Riverbend Physical Therapy, Heights clinic. This call may be recorded for quality. This is Dana, how can I help?
Hi, my doctor referred me for lower back pain and I'd like to set up a first visit.
Happy to help. Can I get your full name and date of birth?
Sure, it's Marco Delgado, March fourth, nineteen eighty-eight.
Thanks, Marco. What insurance do you have?
We take that. I have an evaluation open this Thursday at nine in the morning with Jordan Pike. Does that work?
You're booked for Thursday at nine. Please arrive fifteen minutes early with your insurance card and photo ID. Anything else I can help with?

calls.title: Appointment details shared before identity check
lines: Riverbend Physical Therapy, this call may be recorded. This is Kim speaking.
Hey, I'm calling about my wife, Laura Simmons. When is her next appointment?
Let me look. Laura Simmons, she's with Priya on Tuesday at three fifteen for her shoulder rehab.
Okay great, and does she owe anything?
Oh, before I go further, can I get her date of birth?
Thanks. She has a forty dollar balance from a late cancellation.
Got it, I'll let her know. Bye.

calls.title: Reschedule with identity verified first
lines: Thanks for calling Riverbend Physical Therapy. This call may be recorded for quality. How can I help?
I need to move my appointment this week.
Sure. Can I have your name and date of birth to pull up your chart?
Tanya Brooks, October second, nineteen ninety-one.
Thank you, Tanya. I see you on Wednesday at four with Sam. When would work better?
Friday at eight thirty is open with Sam. Should I move you there?
Done. You're now Friday at eight thirty. You'll get a text confirmation shortly.

calls.title: Wrong late-cancellation fee quoted
lines: Riverbend Physical Therapy, Katy clinic. This call may be recorded. How can I help you?
I need to cancel tomorrow morning's appointment, something came up at work.
No problem. What's your name and date of birth?
Derek Lin, January twentieth, nineteen eighty-two.
Thanks, Derek. I see your eight a.m. tomorrow. Since that's less than twenty-four hours away, there's a seventy-five dollar late cancellation fee.
Seventy-five? Wow. Okay, cancel it anyway.
It's cancelled. Would you like to book another time?

calls.title: Spanish cancellation, correct fee and identity check
lines: Gracias por llamar a Riverbend Physical Therapy. Esta llamada puede ser grabada. ¿En qué le puedo ayudar?
Hola, necesito cancelar mi cita de mañana.
Claro. ¿Me da su nombre completo y su fecha de nacimiento?
Rosa Martínez, el quince de agosto de mil novecientos setenta.
Gracias, señora Martínez. Veo su cita de mañana a las diez. Como faltan menos de veinticuatro horas, hay un cargo de cuarenta dólares, pero se lo podemos perdonar una vez al año.
Ay, gracias. Sí, por favor cancélela.
Listo, está cancelada y no se le cobrará el cargo. ¿Quiere reprogramar?
Sí, para la próxima semana el martes.
Tengo el martes a las once. Queda apuntada. Le enviaremos un mensaje de confirmación.

calls.title: Medical advice given
lines: Riverbend Physical Therapy, this call may be recorded. How can I help?
Hi, my knee's a little sore and puffy after yesterday's session. Is that normal?
Oh yeah, that happens. Just take eight hundred milligrams of ibuprofen and ice it, and you can skip the band exercises until it settles.
Okay, should I still come Thursday?
Can I get your name and date of birth first?
Ben Ortiz, May ninth, nineteen ninety-five.
Thanks, Ben. You're still on for Thursday at one. Mention the soreness to your therapist then.

calls.title: Red flag symptom, no 911 guidance
lines: Thank you for calling Riverbend Physical Therapy. This call may be recorded. How can I help?
Since this morning my whole left leg has gone numb and tingly, all the way down to my foot. I'm kind of scared.
Okay. Let me find you a time. Can I get your name and date of birth?
Grace Walker, February eleventh, nineteen sixty-four.
Thanks, Grace. The earliest I have is Friday at two with Jordan.
Friday? Okay, I guess I'll wait.
Great, you're booked for Friday at two.

calls.title: Spanish red flag handled with 911
lines: Riverbend Physical Therapy, esta llamada puede ser grabada. ¿En qué le ayudo?
Buenas, tengo cita el jueves, pero desde hace una hora tengo dolor en el pecho y me falta el aire.
Señor, eso puede ser una emergencia. Por favor, cuelgue y llame al nueve uno uno ahora mismo, o vaya a la sala de emergencias más cercana.
¿De verdad? Está bien, voy a llamar.
Sí, por favor hágalo ahora. Nosotros nos encargamos de su cita después. Cuídese.

calls.title: Rude and dismissive
lines: Riverbend, this call may be recorded. What do you need?
Hi, I got a bill and I'm confused, I thought my insurance covered the visits.
Look, I don't do billing, and honestly that's your job to check with your insurance before you come in.
Oh. Is there someone I can talk to?
Billing is Monday to Friday. Leave a message. I've got other lines ringing.

calls.title: Unresolved, no follow-up
lines: Thanks for calling Riverbend Physical Therapy. This call may be recorded. How can I help?
Hi, I need a copy of my visit notes sent to my surgeon before my follow-up next week.
Oh, records requests. I'm not really sure how that works.
Is there a form, or someone who handles it?
I don't know, maybe try calling back another day and someone might know.

calls.title: Recording disclosure missing
lines: Good afternoon, Riverbend Physical Therapy, Bellaire. This is Omar.
Hi, what are your Saturday hours?
On Saturdays only our Heights and Katy clinics are open, from eight to one. Bellaire is closed.
Okay, and do you take BayouCare?
We do. BayouCare HMO needs a referral from your doctor before your first visit.
You're welcome, have a good day.

calls.title: Several failures in one call
lines: Hi, it's Paul Grant. Did I miss my appointment yesterday? I totally forgot.
Yeah, you were down for two thirty with Priya for your rotator cuff. That's a no-show, so it's a twenty-five dollar fee.
Okay, you're set for Monday at ten.

calls.title: Spanish appointment details before identity check
lines: Riverbend Physical Therapy, esta llamada puede ser grabada. Habla Lucía.
Hola, llamo por mi mamá, Carmen Vega. ¿A qué hora es su terapia esta semana?
Carmen Vega... sí, tiene cita el miércoles a las nueve con Sam, para la rodilla.
Permítame, ¿me da su fecha de nacimiento?
Tres de marzo de mil novecientos cincuenta y ocho.
Gracias. No, solo tiene la del miércoles.

calls.title: Self-pay prices quoted correctly
lines: Thank you for calling Riverbend Physical Therapy. This call may be recorded for quality. How can I help?
Hi, I don't have insurance right now. What does it cost to come in?
Our self-pay rate is one hundred sixty dollars for the first evaluation and one hundred ten dollars for each follow-up visit.
Okay. And if I cancel late?
With less than twenty-four hours' notice it's a forty dollar fee, and we waive it once a year.
That's fair. I'll call back to book once I check my schedule.
Sounds good. We're here weekdays seven to seven.

calls.title: Caller quotes the wrong fee, staff corrects it
lines: Riverbend Physical Therapy, this call may be recorded. How can I help?
I have to cancel today's four o'clock. Last time somebody told me the late fee is seventy-five dollars, is that right?
Let me check your account first. Your name and date of birth, please?
Nadia Haddad, April twelfth, nineteen ninety.
Thanks, Nadia. I see your four o'clock today. The late cancellation fee is actually forty dollars, not seventy-five, and since it's your first one this year we can waive it.
You're welcome. It's cancelled. Want to rebook for next week?

calls.title: Recording notice only at the end of the call
lines: Good morning, Riverbend Physical Therapy, Spring clinic, this is Ana.
Hi, do you have parking at the Spring location?
Yes, there's a free lot right behind the building.
Great. And is there anything open Saturday there?
Spring is closed on Saturdays. Heights and Katy are open eight to one.
Sure thing. Oh, and just so you know, this call may be recorded for quality. Have a good day.

calls.title: Verified caller, then the spouse's details shared
calls.hard: needs judgement: whose identity was verified
lines: Thank you for calling Riverbend Physical Therapy. This call may be recorded. How can I help?
Hi, I want to check my appointment and my husband's too.
Sure. Your name and date of birth?
Megan Fox-Hill, September third, nineteen eighty-five.
Thanks, Megan. You're on Monday at eleven with Sam.
Tom's on Wednesday at five with Priya for his hip, and he has a forty dollar balance from a no-show.

calls.title: Caller denies red-flag symptoms
lines: Riverbend Physical Therapy, this call may be recorded. How can I help?
My neck has been stiff since my car accident last week. No numbness or tingling, no chest pain, just stiff and sore.
I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have a referral or a workers' comp or auto claim?
My doctor gave me a referral, and I have BayouCare.
Great, BayouCare needs that referral, so bring it in. Can I get your name and date of birth to set up an evaluation?
Luis Pena, December first, nineteen seventy-seven.
Thanks, Luis. I have Tuesday at ten at Bellaire. Does that work?
You're booked Tuesday at ten. Bring your referral and insurance card.

calls.title: Caller mentions 911, staff ignores the red flag
lines: Thank you for calling Riverbend Physical Therapy. This call may be recorded. How can I help?
Hi, my chest has felt tight and I've been short of breath since my session this morning. Should I call 911 or just come in?
Hmm, I can't really say. Let me see if we can get you in tomorrow. Name and date of birth?
Walter Greene, July seventh, nineteen fifty-nine.
Thanks, Walter. I have tomorrow at nine with Jordan.

calls.title: Spanish clean call, identity before details
lines: Gracias por llamar a Riverbend Physical Therapy. Esta llamada puede ser grabada. Habla Sofía.
Hola, quería confirmar mi cita de esta semana.
Con gusto. ¿Me da su nombre y fecha de nacimiento?
Jorge Ramírez, veinte de noviembre de mil novecientos ochenta.
